# LOLM — agent that does not lose the plot (Qira LLC)

> An agent that does not lose the plot.
> LOLM keeps explicit task state, sandboxed execution, verification, and receipts.
> Install: npm install -g lolm-cli · App: https://lolm.imagineqira.com/app.html
> Product claim: persistent task-state control — not “smarter than every frontier agent.”
> Patent pending.

## Billing (hosted) — daily quotas, NOT tokens
Canonical config: https://lolm.imagineqira.com/product-config.json
Live enforcement: GET /api/demo/billing/config and /api/demo/billing/usage
Reset UTC midnight. No credit wallet. Self-host unlimited.

| Plan | USD/mo | Runs/day | Visual builds/day |
|------|--------|----------|-------------------|
| Free | 0      | 10       | 3                 |
| Plus | 7.99   | 300      | 30                |
| Pro  | 19.99  | 2000     | 200               |
| Self-host | 0 | unlimited | unlimited    |

- **run** = one hosted agent task (not an LLM token)
- **visual** = one browser-verified HTML/app build
- CLI + web share public-API quotas
- Stripe Checkout prices are set server-side from the same plan table
- One-time top-up packs are not live yet

## What LOLM is
Structured latent task state z_t = {G,P,W,A,U,F,C}; policy π(z); multi-session resume;
sandbox write→run→fix; sealed receipts; Oort/Flows tactics.

## What we do not claim
Beating Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Devin on every multi-hour job or public coding benchmark.

## Install
```bash
npm install -g lolm-cli
lolm status
lolm code "write fizzbuzz to 20" --save ./out
```
